scope: Frozen 24 TRAIN cases across all six models, three colour/mechanics conditions; four-case Helsinki stereo audit; 48 native held-note receiver observations. The diagnostic colour-neutral branch is not adopted. No new acoustic-source waveform or DEV/SEALED reads.

measurement_conventions.source_unit_midband_error_db: 500 <= f < 1000 Hz power from 40 ms Hann spectra on the frozen 10 ms grid; native minus source after removing the fixed native gain/outputScale.
measurement_conventions.source_unit_broadband_error_db: 20 Hz zero-phase highpass time-domain window power, native minus source; this is distinct from spectral broadband.
measurement_conventions.midband_share_error_db: Difference in 500–1000 Hz / 20 Hz–Nyquist spectral power ratios, using the same 40 ms spectra. It is not midband_error minus the highpass time-power error.
measurement_conventions.alignments: Primary independently detected onsets plus fixed fitted-contact/event timing sensitivity; source front-edge padding limitations retained.

limitations: Matched partial windows include unresolved unisons and potentially noise; they are not source-isolated physical strings.
Source proxy support cannot exclude room/processing or establish stationary noise.
Neither matched peaks nor a partial band deficit proves a missing oscillator: existing lanes can have an inaccurate coherent envelope.
Present Helsinki order2 at68 differs from former fundamental-only82/84/86 trial. No transfer of capacity conclusion.

helsinki_stereo.finding: Recorded G-sharp4 is itself negatively correlated; no universal phase-sign bug. The native second-partial band has excessive late side/mid ratio; overall narrowing would alter recorded character elsewhere. The missing original Helsinki 68 fit cache prevents attribution to the raw fit versus SVD/export stages.

receiver.protocol: Historical Mechanics 1 controlled held-note panel; all 48 original prefixes are sample-exact. Time windows and native STFT remain separate from the frozen Yamaha descriptors.
receiver.inference: Native dry signal is unchanged by pedal; relatively weak broadband receiver output and signed interference explain the reduced core response in this held-state panel. No measured real coupling gain or global Resonance correction follows.

next_required_sound_work: Recover or recompute a tightly scoped TRAIN coherent complex-envelope fit for Helsinki 68/p2 and Belmont 69/p2. Separate current fixed poles, pickup projection and level/phase smoothing from actual native launch/observation. Preserve early level while testing late and stereo residuals.
Extend any successful shared mechanism across all six source families and held-out DEV, retaining regressions. Donor evidence constrains gaps while each target retains its own measured character.
Investigate passive modal interaction from receiver input/transfer evidence; the Yamaha capture limits preclude fitting a global gain to its recorded mixed output.
Adoption still requires acoustic, controller, native C++17, unit, audio, performance and appropriate listening checks.
